_comment: Synthetic THREE-branch MAXIMUM selection aggregate for Issue #1712 (gap G2, partial dominance). Branches neuron-a, neuron-b and neuron-c each feed one MAXIMUM (neuron-maxm). Used to characterise combination dominance: with a suitable observation window, neuron-c never wins the 3-way MAXIMUM (dominated by the combination of a and b) even though it is NOT pairwise-dominated by either a or b alone. Fixtures only - no engine behaviour change. Input neurons are implicit (referenced as input-N).
